blocks.label: The decision
blocks.text: Whether to extend the pilot to the Leeds office before the renewal on 31 March.

blocks.label: Who is waiting on whom
blocks.text: Priya is waiting on Tom for the Leeds seat count. Tom is waiting on you.

blocks.label: Dates
blocks.text: Renewal 31 March. Seat count needed by Friday 13 March.

blocks.label: Your one action
blocks.text: Tell Tom how many Leeds staff need a seat.
